lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 10 distinct vertical white lines; spacing is relatively uniform across the primary torso with a slight increase in distance between the 9th and 10th posterior markers.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The first anterior line is abbreviated, terminating at the mid-shoulder level; the 10th posterior line is a fragmented segment near the upper haunch.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: Four high-contrast white spots visible on the upper posterior haunch and flank area.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: Lyrate silhouette with a dual-axis curvature: an initial posterior-lateral trajectory followed by a medial-anterior terminal hook.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: Ivory-toned tipping is restricted to the terminal 12% of the total horn length.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent white dorsal crest/mane spanning the length of the spine; white V-shaped facial chevron; two distinct white cheek spots; and ochre-colored distal limb segments.
